verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.stripe.com (HTTP 200) and machine-readable .md versions of the Financial Connections docs pages. The official Stripe MCP server can also search Stripe's documentation knowledge base, giving agents several first-party routes into the docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs, and confirmation that llms.txt specifically indexes the Financial Connections pages (it is Stripe-wide).
